pull.title: test: drop `jinja2` dependency from `combine_logs.py`
pull.body:
Use [string.Template](https://docs.python.org/3/library/string.templatelib.html) from the Python std lib instead.
Drop the `--html` option. If you were using this `--html` option, feel free to submit a pull with this commit reverted
